programmes.d: The strange occurrences at Hayden Hill House switch up a gear as whatever is there seems now to be stalking the team with some terrifying results, at least for some of the crew it is proving too much.

This week Yvette Fielding takes her Most Haunted team to Coalville and a house that is surrounded by mystery. The team seem to disturb the rest of some of its long-term residence as they battle through a night of terror.
Once an old foundry, this large old building houses vehicles from a bygone era that are said to still contain passengers whose destination has never ended.
Yvette heads to Presteigne, Mid Wales and the famous Judges Lodgings, were courts were held, people imprisoned and Judges stayed, but it also holds many a secret.
Most Haunted continues its investigation into the Judges Lodgings where the team seem to be under attack and something is trying to get through a door…but what?
This episode features the following cases: The Candlestick, The Diner, From the Agency, The Magic Rose Garden, The Jeep.
This episode features the following cases: The Motorcycle, Blind Man's Dog, Deer Hunters, Tribal Curse, The Card Game.
This episode features the following cases: Red Line, Two Sisters, Eclipse, The Ice Box, The Gathering.
This episode features the following cases: The Dorm, The Child Artist, The Weatherman, Sit-Down Comedian, Room 245.
This episode features the following cases: The Mystery of Douglas Hibbard, Wheelchair Man, The Vigil, The Mandarin's Bowl, Ghost Writer.
Actress Illeana Douglas (Goodfellas, Six Feet Under, Entourage) wants to know who or what was behind the paranormal encounters she had at her former apartment in New York City.
Secrets are revealed when Olympic Ice skater Johnny Weir finally crosses the threshold of the ominous brick building that has petrified him since his childhood in Pennsylvania.
Actress Diane Farr (Numb3rs, Private Practice) fears that a ghost is causing unexplained havoc in her California home.
Comedienne Loni Love returns to the hotel in Winston-Salem, North Carolina where she had an experience so terrifying, she fled in the middle of the night.
Academy award-winning actor Louis Gossett Jr. anxiously returns to the hotel in Louisiana where angry spirits surrounded him over 30 years ago.
Actor Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls, All My Children) has been sensing a dark spirit in his new home, where all of his electronics seem to have minds of their own.
A small room in Laura Prepon's new home leaves her feeling very uneasy; a young Vince Neil hears mysterious noises coming from his bedroom closet.
A young Daryl Hannah meets a mysterious woman who changes her life forever. Maksim Chmerkovskiy recovers from a devastating injury with the help of a woman who's not what she seems.

The team venture into a cottage where it is said ‘no living soul can endure living there’. With cursed dolls, murder and suicide this derelict place has everything to fear, and the team were not disappointed.

We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The foreboding Codnor Castle Cottage maintains its attack on the Most Haunted team with dramatic effect causing Yvette calls an early end to their night in Hell House.
Yvette takes her team to a disused prison in Birmingham which has housed some of the most notorious criminals in British history.

The ruins that make up Dudley Castle house a plethora of paranormal activity for Yvette and her team to investigate. Strange noises and a violent poltergeist await them as they turn the lights out and do battle with the unseen forces that resided there.
Workhouses were not the best of places to be, so why would anyone stay after they had died? Yvette takes her team on a memorable journey to find out.
Whatever was making itself known to the team earlier, continues in this episode as something seems to be following Yvette from the shadows.
Yvette takes the Most Haunted team into the very haunted, disused attic at the top of this huge country mansion and are soon made to feel very unwelcome.

This time Yvette and her team ventures into the dark abyss of the cellars under this large country house. Without exception every member of the team experience something unexplained as the darkness starts to come to life.

Yvette heads to Tamworth and a beautiful manor house that is said to be filled with paranormal occurrences. Almost as soon as the team get there something seems to want to make itself known with dramatic effect.
